answer: Ephemeral Challenge Chains: each identity must answer a fresh challenge whose onyx seed is published only after its response is committed. The enforcement rule requires every reply to cite a thread of prior answers whose hash chain cannot be precomputed, since the seed arrives after commitment. Any reused or copied answer fails verification, forcing attackers to spend a distinct compute cycle per identity. That per-identity cost is the wasted hardware time of solving each unrepeatable puzzle, and the signal of a genuine agent is a chain no other identity can mirror.
